mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:October 2018 HOUST at 1250.0 and RSAFS at 496416.0
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p>0.05) or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong employment growth supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts reading below 1,200,000 units signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200.0 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.5% and inflation accelerates above 2.5%, aggressive monetary tightening depresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:October 2018 FEDFUNDS at 2.19% and CPIAUCSL at 2.52772
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 105.0), declining industrial output reduces corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
